sections.text: Insufficient evidence for a reliable diagnosis. Review the recorded observations and investigation limitations.

sections.title: Observed evidence
sections.text:
Delivery promise cohort and delayed orders: Cohort of 136 promises due in the 82 h ending 2026-10-11T00:00:00.000Z: 80 not delivered by promise (late rate 58.8%). Baseline late rate 28.0% on 125 promises (+110.1% change). 77 order(s) received a delayed status (average recorded delay 5490 min), 4 lost; 85 shipped order(s) are past promise with no delivered or lost event at the cutoff. Simulated fulfilment records; cohort membership is by promise due date, so immature promises never read as healthy.

Inventory levels, depletion and demand velocity: 17 product(s) observed to 2026-10-11T00:00:00.000Z: 0 at zero available units, 0 projected to run out within 72 h at current velocity, 111 units depleted in the 82 h window, 0 out-of-stock checkout failures. No product is currently out of stock. Simulated inventory records derived from canonical inventory.level_changed events.

Review volume, low ratings and delivery complaints: 16 reviews over 82 h ending 2026-10-11T00:00:00.000Z: 0 rated ≤2 (0.0%), average rating 3.94, 7 mention delivery terms. Baseline: 23 reviews, low-rating share 0.0% (n/a change), average rating 4.26, reviews per hour -30.4% change. Most low-rated products: Nike Air Max 90 (0/3), Nike Vomero 18 (0/3), Nike Pegasus 42 (0/2). Simulated review records; delivery mentions are a keyword heuristic.
